name: A Missing Memoir
source:
A man wakes up in a hospital with a gunshot wound and no memory of his life, or even who he is. With no past and no future his only companion is a kind and cheerful nurse. But the past cannot be ignored and it returns to haunt the nameless man once more.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221105090146/http://renai.us/game/m_memoir.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
一名男子在医院醒来，身上带着枪伤，既不记得自己的人生，甚至连自己是谁都想不起来。他没有过去，也看不见未来，唯一陪伴他的只有一名善良开朗的护士。然而过去无法被彻底忽视，它再度归来，纠缠这个无名男子。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221105090146/http://renai.us/game/m_memoir.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
